leftEvidence.title: Witnesses fail; the high priest questions; the council condemns

points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: Jesus is taken to Caiaphas, witnesses seek testimony, two speakers cite the temple saying, the high priest questions Jesus, and the council declares him worthy of death before abuse begins.
points.right: Jesus is brought to Annas, questioned about teaching and disciples, struck after answering, and sent to Caiaphas while Peter’s three denials unfold around the charcoal fire.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
points.right: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.

payload.posture: Matthew’s council hearing and John’s inside-outside sequence preserve different testimony and denial structures.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus questioned inside while Peter denies outside

payload.tension: Matthew moves through failed witnesses to the high priest’s question and condemnation; John alternates Jesus’ questioning with Peter’s denials.
payload.title: Council testimony / questioning and denial
